title: The EU DPP Registry — what it is, and the 11 things we asked the Commission to sharpen
subtitle: Inside the draft Implementing Regulation that will hold every EU Digital Product Passport — and a joint Regen × CircularTech Forum submission to sharpen it before adoption.
featuredImageAlt: The EU DPP Registry as a central node — verification, lookup and log infrastructure connecting five product-regulation regimes
excerpt: The EU's DPP Registry is the operational spine of every Digital Product Passport — spanning ESPR, batteries, construction products, toys and detergents. Today the consultation closes; here is what we asked the Commission to sharpen.
